title: Pathology lab
seo_description: Pathology lab software for diagnostic labs: register tests, enter and validate results, track every sample, and release signed reports with a full audit trail.

fields.hero_title: Pathology lab software, from test order to validated result
fields.hero_lead: Register tests with the patient case, enter and validate results, and release reports only after an authorized doctor signs them. Every step is recorded against a named user.
fields.features:
Tests registered with the patient case and bill
Results entered by technicians and validated before release
Report templates for each test
Barcode tracking for every tube
Digital signature, then send to patient and doctor
Every edit kept with the user, time, and reason

steps.title: Register
steps.text: The front desk adds the patient, the tests, and the payment in one screen.

steps.title: Test and validate
steps.text: Technicians enter results; each case is validated before it moves to reporting.

steps.title: Sign and send
steps.text: An authorized doctor signs, and the report goes to the patient and the referring doctor.

fields.cta_title: See pathology lab with your own setup
fields.cta_text: Bring your test menu and price list. We will show you a patient case from registration to signed report, configured the way your team works.
